note: The game rules mod file (mod content type 'gamerules', file gamerules.json). Data, not code: the runtime reads these values instead of constants. A missing key keeps the built-in default, so a mod only lists what it changes. Merge rule: mods load in order and a later mod overrides individual keys of an earlier one; a list value (water_biomes) replaces the whole list; zones are keyed by id and a later zone with the same id replaces the earlier one.

grid_size_m.note: Size of one ground grid square in metres. Plants are placed on square centres. Should match the ground grid drawn by the scene.

reach_cells.note: How many squares away from the player's own square a plant can be placed (1 = own square plus the eight around it).

max_slope_deg.note: Steepest ground (degrees) that can be planted.

crop_spacing_m.note: Minimum distance between two planted crops.

tree_spacing_m.note: Minimum distance between two planted trees.

water_biomes.note: Biome ids that can never be planted in, whatever a group's own planting.biomes says.

reach_cells.note: How many squares away from the player's own square a plant can be harvested.
How many squares around the player's own square a structure or prop can be placed.

rotate_step_deg.note: Degrees one press of R turns the item being placed (Shift+R turns the other way).

starter_zone.note: Rules for the land tile the player begins in (the centre of the map by default). World generation enforces them whatever the seed: a square of ground around the spawn point is some form of grass, there is at least one water feature in the zone, and water covers no more than max_water_fraction of the zone. The rest of the zone is ordinary biome generation.

tile.note: [x, z] land tile (0-4 on the 5 x 5 grid of 100 m tiles) that counts as the starter zone. The player spawns at its centre.

grass_area_m.note: Side length in metres of the square around the spawn point (the centre of the tile) whose land is always one of land_biomes. 0 turns the grass area off.

land_biomes.note: Biome ids the grass area's land is made of (patchy mix; biome_maintained_grass is left out on purpose, it only comes from the player). Every non-water point in the grass area is one of these.

min_water_features.note: At least this many rivers or ponds must have water inside the zone. A small pond is added when the seed gave none.

max_water_fraction.note: Water may cover at most this fraction of the zone's area. Rivers are narrowed and ponds shrunk or removed until it holds.

starter_road.note: The dirt and gravel road from a map edge to the edge of the starter grass area. Generated with the world: routed around water and steep ground, soft and meandering, never straight, and painted by the terrain shader (procedural dirt and gravel with ruts). Trees, rocks and flowers keep off it.

width_m.note: Width of the road surface in metres, edge to edge (it varies a little along the road).

meander_m.note: How far the road wanders from side to side, in metres, on top of the turns it makes to avoid water and hills. 0 = only those turns.

zones.note: Rectangular patches of ground that count as a biome for planting rules on flat-ground worlds (no generated terrain). The game builds a flat textured quad for each one at load.

id.note: Unique zone id; a later mod's zone with the same id replaces this one.

biome.note: Biome id the zone counts as (e.g. biome_farmland). Growth groups whose planting.biomes list it can be planted inside.

center.note: [x, z] world position of the zone's centre.

texture.note: PNG path relative to the mod root, tiled across the zone. Omitted = an untextured quad.

tile_m.note: Metres covered by one repeat of the texture.

height_offset_m.note: How far above the ground the quad sits.

graphics.note: Graphics quality presets (Settings > Graphics > Preset). A preset only changes how the world is DRAWN, never what is in it: tree and bush positions and the save records come from the world seed, so density is not a quality setting. Auto picks the highest preset whose min_vram_mb and min_cores the machine meets. The presets list replaces the built-in one; list them lowest quality first.

default_preset.note: The preset a new player starts with: 'auto' or a preset id.

name.note: The name shown in the dropdown.

min_vram_mb.note: Graphics memory Auto needs to pick this preset.

min_cores.note: CPU cores Auto needs to pick this preset.

shadow_distance.note: Metres the sun casts shadows; 0 = no shadows.

shadow_resolution.note: Size of the sun's shadow map (1024, 2048, 4096).

render_scale.note: Share of the screen resolution the world is drawn at (0.5 to 1.5).

small_plant_range.note: Metres from the middle of the view that flowers, tufts and bushes are drawn.

terrain_blend.note: The soft biome boundaries on the terrain. Off = hard edges (the cheapest).

max_fps.note: Frame rate cap with V-Sync off; 0 = none.

antialiasing.note: Anti-aliasing: off, fxaa, smaa, msaa2, msaa4 or msaa8. FXAA / SMAA are cheap post-process smoothing; MSAA costs more frame rate and graphics memory. The player can override it in Settings.

water_reflections.note: The sky reflected in water (Fresnel-weighted, from the environment). Off = only the sun's glint. Costs very little; the player can override it in Settings.
